headline: Congress renamed a Postal Service facility in Muskego, Wisconsin, after Colonel Hans Christian Heg.
what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service building at S74w16860 Janesville Road in Muskego, Wisconsin, the Colonel Hans Christian Heg Post Office. Heg was a Norwegian-born Union Army colonel in the Civil War. The change is only a name change and does not alter postal services, rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024, and the new name applies from that date.
